summary: Installing the self-service automation portal Helm chart in a disconnected OpenShift cluster: set MY_NAMESPACE and MY_CLUSTER_ROUTER_BASE, create the project, and write values-oci.yaml with clusterRouterBase, pluginMode oci, imageTagInfo, imageRegistry, optional ociPluginImage, a tag-based rhdh-hub-rhel9 image (digests aren't kept when mirroring), checkSSL and the rhaap catalog provider.
questions: How do I install the self-service portal Helm chart offline?
Why do I need to override the rhdh image tag when mirroring?
What is imageRegistry in the self-service portal values?
